spanish: En el día el octavo, atséret será a ustedes; toda obra de servicio no harán ustedes.

findings.issue: עֲצֶרֶת is a common noun (HNcfsa, H6116), left as the untranslated transliteration atséret.

notes: Remaining tokens match: day, eighth, 3fs be, to-you 2mp, all work-of service, negative, 2mp do.
